groups.activity: pledge Cephalon Suda, then Steel Meridian; rank all three to Rank 2

rows.label: Cephalon Suda to Intriguing
rows.note: 500 Circuits + 10k cr, 2 Control Module + 30k cr, Forma + 50k cr

rows.label: Arbiters of Hexis to Authentic
rows.note: 500 Alloy Plate + 10k cr, 2 Gallium + 30k cr, Forma + 50k cr

rows.label: Steel Meridian to Valiant
rows.note: 1,000 Salvage + 10k cr, 2 Morphics + 30k cr, Forma + 50k cr

conditions: Relay syndicates open at MR 3. The daily cap, 16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank, is shared across all faction syndicates.
Rank 1 spends 5,000 standing and Rank 2 spends 22,000 on top of the sacrifices.
bonuses: Suda and Hexis are allies, so pledging Suda fills Hexis at half rate; Meridian's losses land only on New Loka and Perrin.
Syndicate alert standing and medallions ignore the daily cap; a syndicate offers alerts from Rank 1.

disclosures.title: death squads
disclosures.body: Suda sinks New Loka and Red Veil, Hexis sinks Red Veil and Perrin, Meridian sinks Perrin and New Loka. Any of those going negative sends Eximus hit squads into random missions; they're a nuisance and drop specter blueprints.

groups.activity: buy one part from each syndicate
conditions: Stop at Rank 2; Rank 3 buys nothing Corvas needs.

rows.label: level to 30
rows.note: on a Necramech, or Archwing on Salacia, Neptune

conditions: Corvas (Atmosphere) is the same weapon on the ground; one Mastery entry.
bonuses: An Orokin Catalyst plus a Gravimag lets the Archgun Deployer bring it into any ground mission, where it levels about like a normal gun.
